scene_context.physical_setting: Casual dining restaurant with wooden booths and warm lighting
scene_context.emotional_atmosphere: Initially casual and routine, shifting abruptly to highly emotional and celebratory

characters.physical_description: Adult male, heavy set, wearing a dark blue work shirt with yellow reflective safety stripes, appears dusty/dirty

initial_state.body_language_summary: Standing with hands on hips (akimbo), relaxed but tired posture, casual conversation distance

final_state.body_language_summary: Engaged in tight embrace, body shaking (sobbing), holding onto other person securely
final_state.apparent_goal: To maintain physical closeness with the returning individual

behavioral_evidence: Shift from static standing to rapid approach

characters.physical_description: Adult male, wearing military camouflage fatigues

initial_state.body_language_summary: Approaching stealthily from behind, smiling, anticipating reaction

final_state.body_language_summary: Reciprocating hug, patting back of person_work_uniform

characters.physical_description: Female, seated at booth, wearing plaid shirt

initial_state.body_language_summary: Seated, looking between person_work_uniform and the background
behavioral_evidence: Engaging person_work_uniform in conversation to distract him

desire_motivation_analysis.reasoning_chain: Subject enters restaurant -> Engages in casual banter with family member -> Posture is relaxed -> Indicates desire to maintain social bond and participate in meal.

supporting_evidence.description: Walks to table and stands with hands on hips, engaging in conversation.

alternative_interpretations.reasoning: He is at a restaurant and mentions being taken out to eat.
alternative_interpretations.why_not_primary: His primary focus is social interaction (talking to daughter) rather than looking at menu or food initially.

desire_motivation_analysis.reasoning_chain: Subject spots person_military_uniform -> Immediate orienting response -> Rapid approach behavior -> Tight embrace -> Indicates overwhelming desire for physical closeness and reconnection.

supporting_evidence.description: Rapidly closes distance between self and soldier.
Throws arms around soldier in a bear hug.

trigger_event.description: Visual identification of person_military_uniform standing behind him

behavioral_markers.description: Hands drop from hips, body orients fully toward the soldier.
Mouth opens, expression shifts to shock/joy.

desire_transitions.visual_marker_of_change: The moment his hands drop from his hips and he lunges forward.
desire_transitions.psychological_interpretation: A classic 'Expectation Violation' where a new belief (son is here) triggers an immediate, high-intensity emotional and behavioral response, overriding the previous low-arousal state.

behavioral_sequence.behavior_description: Standing with hands on hips (akimbo), weight shifted to one leg.
Turns 180 degrees, eyes widen, freezes momentarily.
behavioral_sequence.inferred_mental_state: Disbelief, cognitive processing of unexpected stimulus.
behavioral_sequence.relevance_to_desire: Marks the transition point where the new desire emerges.

behavioral_sequence.behavior_description: Eliminates all distance, engages in full-body embrace, lifting the other person slightly.
behavioral_sequence.inferred_mental_state: Overwhelming joy, relief, need for contact.
behavioral_sequence.relevance_to_desire: Consummatory behavior satisfying the affiliation desire.

key_segments_for_qa.segment_description: The moment of realization and reaction.
key_segments_for_qa.psychological_significance: Perfect example of belief revision triggering emotional and motivational shift.

inter_character_dynamics.mutual_influence: The presence of person_military_uniform completely alters the emotional state and motivation of person_work_uniform.

annotation_metadata.annotation_notes: The relationship is inferred as father/son based on the intensity of the hug and the 'Hey Dad' audio cue, though annotation relies primarily on the visual evidence of the embrace.
